mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, the canonical twenty-eight-period Vertical Horizontal Filter first crossing into a strong-trend state on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks conversion of noisy travel into directional displacement; follow the sign of the same-window net close displacement for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: at a strict VHF upward crossing of 0.4, long when current close exceeds the close 28 bars earlier and short when it is lower
mechanism.why_distinct: VHF divides the close range by total absolute close travel and therefore measures path efficiency without ADX directional movement, return magnitude threshold, range location, recursive filter, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the trend-efficiency onset must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse path-efficiency trend-onset clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.close_range: highest minus lowest completed close over latest 28 bars
features.absolute_travel: sum of latest 28 absolute completed close changes, requiring 29 uninterrupted closes
features.vhf: close_range divided by absolute_travel, invalid at zero denominator
features.trend_onset: current VHF strictly above 0.4 after immediately prior VHF at or below 0.4
features.direction: sign of current completed close minus close 28 bars earlier, invalid at zero
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical VHF(28) strong-trend onset with same-window displacement direction under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, formula, threshold, displacement direction, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Adam White, canonical Vertical Horizontal Filter
external_basis.fixed_definition: 28 completed closes; VHF=(highest close-lowest close)/sum of 28 absolute close changes; strong-trend boundary 0.4 as in the published platform example; direction from same-window net close displacement
external_basis.selection_use: published period, formula, trend-state example boundary, and contemporaneous displacement interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
